name: Wave Progress Bar
description: Turns the in-level progress bar into a wave that zigzags along it, using your equipped wave icon.

hide-fill.name: Hide Original Progress Bar
hide-fill.description: Hide the normal progress bar (track and fill) so only the wave is shown.

icon-scale.name: Wave Icon Scale
icon-scale.description: Size of your wave icon relative to the progress bar. 1.0 is about the height of the bar.

zigzag-height.name: Zigzag Height
zigzag-height.description: How tall the zigzag is, relative to the bar's height. 1.0 fills most of the bar, higher values spill over it.

zigzag-style.name: Zigzag Style
zigzag-style.description: Classic: even 45 degree zigzag from top to bottom. Chaotic: uneven turns, like a real wave section (the same level always gives the same pattern).

trail-thickness.name: Trail Thickness
trail-thickness.description: Thickness of the wave trail relative to the progress bar. 2.0 matches the size of the wave icon well.

trail-length.name: Trail Length (%)
trail-length.description: How much of the bar the trail covers behind the wave. 100 keeps the whole trail, lower values leave a short tail.

trail-color.name: Trail Color
trail-color.description: Which of your icon colors the trail uses.

trail-outline.name: Wave Path Outline
trail-outline.description: Show the whole path the wave will take, with a black, white, black outline like the vanilla progress bar. The path fills up with the wave trail as you progress.

solid-trail.name: Solid Wave Trail
solid-trail.description: Turn this on to remove the thin white line down the middle of the wave trail, so it is one solid color.

mini-wave.name: Mini Wave
mini-wave.description: Use the mini wave: a smaller icon and trail, and a steeper zigzag (about 63 degrees instead of 45).

vertical-offset.name: Vertical Offset
vertical-offset.description: Moves the wave down (positive) or up (negative), measured in progress bar heights. The wave is also automatically kept from going past the top of the screen.
